reviewType: independent read-only pre-activation review, not runtime acceptance

findings.finding: Scanning all qa/source-monitor would include tracked live-review-1 evidence and fail the scheduler allowlist after possible delivery.
findings.resolution: Only scheduler-owned ci-ID-attempt-check/ack directories are traversed; tracked unrelated evidence has a preservation regression.

findings.finding: Missing run numbers and old reruns could restore stale send history, permitting duplicate POSTs.
findings.resolution: Require exactly the immediately previous run number and reject every rerun. Follow-up review showed that deleting a newer run hides it from discovery; rejecting only visible-newer reruns was insufficient. Deleted-newer regression added.

findings.finding: Archive capacity was checked after delivery; an oversize upload-visible archive or no checkpoint could remain.
findings.resolution: Reserve worst-case growth before external IO, enforce writer size bounds, validate stored ZIP before exclusive staged write/readback/hardlink publication. Capacity crossing tests verify no external operation or journal initialization.

finalDisposition: Final blocker closed by inspection. No remaining blocker from this review. Tests were not rerun by reviewer; this is not activation or runtime acceptance.
implementationScope: Explicit local/git anchor profile propagation through monitor, runner and acknowledgement, checked again between notice IO; 80 new synthetic cases.
